mapper.sql: select t.id, t.tenant_id, t.tenant_name, t.tenant_desc, t.trade_info, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.province_id, t.city_id, t.county_id, t.is_operation, t.status, p.AREA_NAME as province_name, c.AREA_NAME as city_name, co.AREA_NAME as county_name from sys_tenant_info t left join sys_area p on t.province_id = p.AREA_CODE left join sys_area c on t.city_id= c.AREA_CODE left join sys_area co on t.county_id= co.AREA_CODE
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.USER_NAME, t.TENANT_ID, t.TENANT_NAME FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info t ON u.TENANT_ID = t.TENANT_ID WHERE u.user_type='2' and is_tenant_admin=1 and t.del_flag = '0' and u.DEL_FLAG = '0' and (u.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{keyword}, '%' ) OR t.tenant_name LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{keyword}, '%' ) OR u.tenant_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ${dataScope}
